Minimum qualification checklist (what we need from Foundry to approve a temporary boost):
1) Confirm account owner and billing contact (name + email)
2) Signed MSA or DocuSign intent form (we can send a conditional DocuSign that covers the trial period)
3) SOC 2 evidence (you mentioned this is in flight) or an ETA on completion

5) Target start date and an expected token burn estimate (you requested 400k tokens)

If those are in order we can provision a temporary boost and promo allocation for 6 weeks pinned to us-west. I’ve attached an internal SLA draft and we can issue a short-term addendum for the trial once legal signs off.
